title: Summary
summary: Exercise and nutrition over a day or a run of days.
description: The Summary tab answers whether the training and the eating are on track over more than one day.

stories.want: to see my cardio minutes against a weekly target
stories.soThat: I know whether I need another session before the week ends

stories.want: a checkmark on the nutrients I aim for
stories.soThat: I can see at a glance whether I have had enough of them

requirements.text: The Summary's period is chosen from `summary.periods`, defaulting to Last 7 days, and steps back and forward by its own length, never past today.

history.text: The Summary's period is chosen from `summary.periods`, defaulting to Last 7 days, with navigation between dates.
history.reason: Version 1 said only that dates can be navigated, which couldn't be checked.

requirements.text: The 7-day cardio target is `cardio.weekly-target`; the 24-day target is four times it and a day's is a seventh of it.

history.text: The 7-day cardio target is `cardio.weekly-target` and can be changed; the 24-day target is four times the 7-day one.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the target cannot be changed in the app, and the Day view's share was missing.

requirements.text: A workout counts its full duration as cardio when its average heart rate is above `cardio.min-avg-hr`; at exactly that value, or with no average, it does not.
A workout's Cardio switch overrides the automatic rule, including after edits and re-syncs, until the user chooses to use the automatic rule again.
Each workout records its Zone 2 minutes separately from whether it counts as cardio.

history.text: Zone 2 minutes are tracked separately from cardio minutes.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: the Summary shows no Zone 2 total; the minutes live on each workout.

requirements.text: Over a multi-day period, nutrition is shown as per-day averages over every day of the period, days without data included.

history.text: Over a multi-day period, nutrition is shown as per-day averages.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't say what the average divides by.

requirements.text: Energy, goals, keto, macros, micronutrients and other compounds are each shown as a card, with supplements counted in the same totals as food.

history.text: Energy and macros are always visible; keto, micronutrients, source filters and other compounds are under Nutrition details.
history.reason: Version 1 didn't match the product: there is no Nutrition details section and no source filter.

requirements.text: In Settings → Goals the user picks the nutrients to check off, each with a daily amount of their own; none are picked until they do.

On the Summary, each picked nutrient's row shows a checkmark when the amount shown reaches its daily amount, and an empty mark when it doesn't; over a multi-day period the amount shown is the per-day average.
